situation: My boyfriend broke up with me because he didn't want a relationship with someone who had kids.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hello, how are you today?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I'm really upset about a break up I just had with my boyfriend.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I am sorry, when did this happen?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: It happened two days ago.  I can't believe he led me on for almost a year knowing that I had two children and all of a sudden decided that he didn't want to deal with kids.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I can understand the pain you must feel and the betrayal, that is absolutely awful.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I do.  I don't understand why he was fine with my kids for almost a  year and all of a sudden it changed.  I'm completely blindsided.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: How are your children doing through this?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: They don't know yet.  I didn't want to upset them right before Christmas.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: What a terrible thing for him to do. I agree with you not to upset them right before Christmas.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I'm not really sure how to break it to them when I do finally tell them.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: That is always a tough one. My suggestion is to not put him in a bad light since they do not have the angry feelings toward him that you do. Maybe tell them that he has made some choices in life that doesn't involve you, and unfortunately, we cannot control people and their feelings.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: That is a good idea.  That would be good so they don't think it has anything to do with them because I'd never want them to feel bad about it!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Exactly, that is a burden that children should never have to endure. They are always the innocent victims in our personal problems.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Hopefully they don't ask me what choices he made and want details.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: True! How old are they?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: They are 6 and 8 years old

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: They should hopefully be young enough not to want details. Maybe if they ask say he didn't give you details because he apparently doesn't know himself what he wants. You sound like a very caring mother who wants the very best for her children.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: thank you!

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Knowing someone thinks I'm a good mother makes me feel a little better about the situation!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I have a daughter and we have went through something similar in the past so I can relate. The truth is, I have found over time that it is our children who get us through these tough time.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Yes, seeing their faces tomorrow when they open presents will help get me through this sad time!

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: You will get through this and come out ahead in the long run, just stay strong!

seeker_question1: The supporter shared a similar situation in their life
